blocks.removed: 1. Do not promote post-1.0 pool ADRs into active work.

conditions.quote: Do not promote post-1.0 pool ADRs into active work.
conditions.reason: Boundary 1 retired by operator ruling 2026-09-29 (GHI #818): superseded by the Magna Carta's release prioritization; a pool ADR carries near-zero liability.

blocks.removed: 2. Do not add more pool ADRs to the runtime track.

conditions.quote: Do not add more pool ADRs to the runtime track.
conditions.reason: Boundary 2 retired by operator ruling 2026-09-29 (GHI #818): the pool may grow without practical limit; promotion selection is carried by ADR-pool.pool-management § 9.

blocks.removed: 3. Do not build the graph engine without locking state doctrine first.

conditions.quote: Do not build the graph engine without locking state doctrine first.
conditions.reason: Boundary 3 retired as fulfilled by operator ruling 2026-09-29 (GHI #818): state doctrine is locked by ADR-0.0.9 (Validated).

blocks.removed: 5. Do not let AirlineOps parity become perpetual catch-up.

conditions.quote: Do not let AirlineOps parity become perpetual catch-up.
conditions.span: Do not let AirlineOps parity become perpetual catch-up: gzkit leads and AirlineOps adopts; gzkit does not chase AirlineOps patches.

blocks.removed: 6. Do not let derived views silently become source-of-truth — `gz status`, pipeline markers, and reconciliation caches are Layer 3; every fact traces to Layer 1 canon or Layer 2 ledger.
